metadata.ensemble: NVT; fixed periodic box, no barostat
metadata.preprocessing: Removed crystal waters; added hydrogens at pH 7; solvated and neutralized with NaCl
metadata.alignment: Each C-alpha frame is centered and Kabsch-aligned to the first sampled production frame
metadata.rmsd_reference: First sampled production frame; same 76 C-alpha atoms
metadata.sampling_note: An initial frame and each sampled chunk; timestamps preserve any final partial interval
metadata.purpose: Real, short local MD for an educational software demo
limitations: Picosecond-scale software demonstration; not a new biological discovery.
The short setup protocol does not establish equilibration or convergence.
No inference about protein function, stability, disease, or drug efficacy.
Only C-alpha coordinates are exported; solvent and other atoms remain in the simulated system.
Alignment removes rigid translation and rotation; the display shows internal motion.
A random seed records initialization; exact trajectories can differ across hardware or software builds.
